# Zeynel İnegöl Köftecisi

## Brand

Zeynel İnegöl Köftecisi - İnegöl köfte restaurant in Bursa, Turkey, operating since 1961 as a 3rd generation family business.

Website: https://zeynelkofte.com
Email: zeynel@zeynelkofte.com
Instagram: @zeynelkofte (https://www.instagram.com/zeynelkofte/)

**Phone:** +90 540 520 16 16

## Important Rules

- Zeynel İnegöl Köftecisi'nin yalnızca iki şubesi vardır: Kayhan Çarşısı ve Mobilium AVM.
- Menü linki yalnızca Mobilium içindir: https://menucebimde.com/?menuid=0LKC7M
- For Kayhan Çarşı menu inquiries, direct customers to call the branch.
